thread:
incbot: Pager: High error rate from /generate for hosted-inference in eu-west-1. Sev 2 triggered. Incident ID INC-2028-0912.

Eva (oncall): I’m on it — investigating latency spikes and 5xxs. Starting with router and model pool.

Devon (Eng SRE): Noted. I’ll check autoscaler logs and any recent deploys. Can you confirm scope (customers / routes)?

Eva (oncall): Seen errors across multiple customer routes hitting hosted /generate. Initial sampling shows increased 5xx for requests >512 tokens.

Olivia (Eng): There was a performance tweak rolled out to the batching kernel ~25m ago in eu-west-1. Rolling back now to test.

incbot: Deploy rollback for commit abc123 initiated by Olivia. ETA 4m.

Devon (Eng SRE): Autoscaler/queue backlogs look normal. KV cache growth is high for long seqs; could be mem pressure triggering occasional OOM -> 502s. Rolling rollback in parallel is good.

Eva (oncall): Mitigation: 1) rollback in progress 2) apply temporary rate-limit to long requests (>1024 tokens) for hosted tier to reduce memory pressure. Applying now.

Priya (Support): Any ETA for stable? A few customers already pinged support. Need a short statement we can post on status and share with customers.

Liam (Account Mgmt): We should flag customers on Dedicated capacity who might be affected (they expect isolation). Also start preparing SLA credit assessment if we exceed degraded SLA window.

Nikhil (Billing): I’ll standby for credit calc — need incident window, impacted customers, and whether this qualifies under our SLA terms (availability vs request success rate).

Olivia (Eng): Rollback finished. Initial metrics show error rate dropping. Rolling out verification across nodes.

incbot: Incident status changed to "Mitigating". Error rate trending down from 6.2% -> 1.1% over 7 minutes.

Devon (Eng SRE): Confirming: error rate now ~0.8% cluster-wide, latency returning to baseline. Will keep monitoring for 30m.

Eva (oncall): Good. For customer comms: draft status update -> short, non-technical, acknowledge issue, impacted timeframe, mitigation, next steps, and contact link. Draft below for review.

Eva (oncall): DRAFT (for status.redwood.com and support):
```
We experienced elevated error rates for generation requests in eu-west-1 between 2028-09-12T10:02:14Z and 2028-09-12T10:24:30Z. The issue affected some hosted API requests, primarily long-sequence generation. We mitigated the problem by rolling back a recent runtime change and applying temporary safeguards; normal service has been restored. If you experienced errors during this window, please contact support and include request IDs where possible. We are evaluating impact and will follow up with any eligible SLA credit information.
```

Priya (Support): LGTM. Add a one-line "no customer data was exposed" security line.

Eva (oncall): Added. New draft ready to post once Devon gives final OK on metrics.

Devon (Eng SRE): Metrics hold: 30m observation window looks clean. Approve posting.

Liam (Account Mgmt): For customers asking about credits: we should proactively compute eligibility for customers with >0.5% additional error rate above baseline across the incident window. Nikhil can you do a list of impacted accounts by tomorrow EOD?

Nikhil (Billing): I will. Provide me with: incident ID, precise start/end timestamps, per-tenant request counts and error counts for the window and baseline window (prior 24h). I’ll run the SLA calc and draft credit memos.

Devon (Eng SRE): I’ll dump per-tenant metrics and attach to the billing ticket. ETA 2 hours.

Priya (Support): Template for customer reply when forwarding to Billing — short + empathetic. Use this: "We sincerely apologize for the disruption... our team has identified the cause and mitigated it. We will assess eligibility for service credits and follow up within 48 hours."

Eva (oncall): Posting status page now.

incbot: Status page update posted: "Elevated error rates for generation requests in eu-west-1 — mitigated (INC-2028-0912)".

Devon (Eng SRE): Uploaded metrics export to internal ticket RED-INC-1842101234-billing with per-tenant CSV.

Nikhil (Billing): Received the CSV. Running automated SLA eligibility script. Quick note on policy: we credit when uptime or success-rate SLA is violated per contract thresholds. For hosted-tier standard SLA we consider aggregated success rate; for Dedicated we check isolation guarantees. Will flag any enterprise accounts requiring manual review.

Liam (Account Mgmt): For enterprise customers we’ll coordinate a personalized note. Tagging accounts with committed SLAs.

Nikhil (Billing): Preliminary run: 14 hosted tenants saw error-rate delta >0.5% during window; three of those have usage high enough to qualify for a prorated credit per the SLA formula. Draft credit amounts will be attached in the billing ticket.

Priya (Support): I’ll send a curated message to the impacted customers now linking the status page and saying billing will follow up within 48h. Template:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We saw elevated errors affecting generation calls in eu-west-1 between 10:02 and 10:24 UTC. Service is restored. We're assessing impact and billing will reach out about any eligible credits. If you have request IDs or specific incidents, please forward them.
Apologies for the disruption — Priya from Support
```

Eva (oncall): Good. Post-incident action items: 1) Root cause postmortem (assigned Olivia, Devon) due in 3 business days. 2) Run QA on runtime kernel changes with larger sequence length tests. 3) Add canary gating to avoid global rollout for batching kernel changes.

Olivia (Eng): Will own RC postmortem and the canary plan update.

Devon (Eng SRE): I’ll coordinate the QA harness and provide additional telemetry for long-seq signals.

Nikhil (Billing): Once the billing ticket has final numbers I’ll create the credit invoices and send to customers. Timeline: draft by EOD, final dispatch within 48h.

Liam (Account Mgmt): I’ll review high-value accounts before billing sends.

Eva (oncall): Thanks everyone. Closing thread for real-time coordination; leave notes in the RED-INC ticket for followups. If error rate flares again, reopen. :thumbsup:

incbot: Incident status changed to "Resolved (monitoring)". Incident closed at 2028-09-12T10:34:50Z."
